verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents creating invoices with customizable online payment options, including cards, ACH, Apple Pay, Google Pay and BNPL. Payment status is only indirectly covered through a Payments Collected report and the Payments API. The pack never documents sending invoices or tracking when a client views one. Bill Pay's 'created to paid' tracking is for vendor bills, so it doesn't count. missing for 10: documented invoice sending/delivery, invoice viewed-status tracking, explicit per-invoice paid-status visibility, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: Get paid with credit and debit cards, ACH bank transfer, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Buy Now, Pay Later
